title: Invasion Fronts in Shifting Habitats and Competition Systems: A Hamilton-Jacobi Approach and Nonlocal Effects
summary: We review recent developments in the study of spreading phenomena in reaction--diffusion equations arising from ecological invasion models. Motivated by the conjecture of Shigesada and Kawasaki on staged invasions, we discuss how competition systems can lead to effective scalar models with shifting habitats. We present the Hamilton--Jacobi approach for determining spreading speeds and revisit the result of {Li--Bewick--Shang--Fagan} (2014) from this perspective.
